description.value: Clough Club is a compact cocktail bar in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, named after the area's old-timey one-armed lamp lighter. The intimate 1,600 sq. ft. space seats 33 and accommodates 50 standing, with an experienced bar team serving strong custom cocktails and small plates. Live music runs on weekends and a private back room is available for group bookings.

No cyclist-specific amenities—bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging—are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, leaving those fields null. The 'Closed Today' banner on the website reflects a day-of-week schedule status rather than permanent closure; OSM check_date is 2026-04-04 with looks_closed: false, and the site actively promotes event bookings.
